simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אָדוֹן (H113) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 329 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: אָדוֹן (ʼâdôwn) means sovereign , i.e. controller (human or divine) First listed occurrence: 1Chr 12 20.

definitions.usage: lord, master, owner. Compare also names beginning with 'Adoni-'.
definitions.full: H113. adon אָדוֺן noun masculine Mal 3:1 lord (Phoenician אדן ) — ׳א Psa 12:5 +? אֲדוֺן Josh 3:11 +; plural אֲדֹנִים Isa 26:13 +; construct אֲדֹנֵי Deut 10:17 +; suffix אֲדֹנֵינוּ 1Sam 25:14 + etc.; ( אֲדֹנָי אֲדֹנַי, אֲדֹנִי, are variations of Masoretic pointing to distinguish divine reference from human. Plural, with few except an intensive plural of rank; word takes suffix as plural in all other person; so doubtless here. Orig. reading probably in all cases אֲדֹנַי (see Dalm Der Gottesname Adonaj ; Lag BN 188 makes אֲדֹנָי an Aramaic formative); אֲדֹנִי now found in J 51 t.; in E Gen 31:35 ; 32:19 ; 42:10 ; Exod 21:5 ; in P Gen 23:6 , 11 , 15 ; Num 36:2 (twice in verse); often Samuel & Kings; in Chronicles only in sources, 1Chr 21:3 (3 t. in verse); 21:23 (= 2Sam 24:3 , 22 ) 2Chr 2:13 ; 2:14 ; Isaiah & Jeremiah only in historical parts Isa 36:8-9 , 12 ; Jer 37:20 ; 38:9 ; elsewhere Dan 1:10 ; 10:16-17 , 19 ; 12:8 ; Zech 1:9 ; 4:4-5 , 13 ; 6:4 ; Psa 110:1 ; Judg 4:18 ; 6:13 ; Ruth 2:13 ; אֲדנָי בִּי Exod 4:10 , 13 ; Josh 7:8 (J) Judg 6:15 ; 13:8 is referred to God, but אֲדנִי בִּי Gen 43:20 ; 44:18 ; Num 12:11 (J) 1Sam 1:26 ; 25:24 ; 1Kin 3:17 , 26 reference to human superiors. There is uncertainty as to אֲדֹנָ֯י Gen 18:3 ; 19:18 ; אֲדֹ֯נַי 19:2 ) — 1 singular lord, master (1) reference to men: ( a ) superintendent of household, or of affairs Gen 45:8-9 , (E) = Psa 105:21 ; ( b ) master 12:5 ; ( c ) king Jer 22:18 ; 34:5 ; (2) reference to God, יהוה הָאָדוֺן the Lord Yahweh (see יהוה ) Exod 23:17 ; 34:23 (Cov't codes); כָּלהָֿאָרֶץ אֲרוֺן Lord of the whole earth Josh 3:11 , 13 (J) Psa 97:5 ; Zech 4:14 ; 6:5 ; Micah 4:13 ; ׳הָא ׳י צֻבָאוֺת , earlier Isa 1:24 ; 3:1 ; 10:33 ; 19:4 ( אֲדֹנָי 10:16 in common MT; not Massora, doubtless scribal error); ׳הָא Mal 3:1 ; אָדוֺן Psa 114:7 . 2 plural lords, kings Deut 10:17 = Psa 136:3 ; Isa 26:13 ; elsewhere intensive plural of rank, lord, master , (1) reference to men: ( a ) proprietor of hill Samaria 1Kin 16:24 ; ( b ) master Gen 40:7 (E) Exod 21:4 (twice in verse); 21:6 , 8 , 32 (Cov't code) Gen 24:9 + (J, 11 t.) Deut 23:16 ; Judg 19:11-12 , 13 t. Samuel & Kings; Job 3:19 ; Psa 123:2 ; Prov 25:13 ; 27:18 ; 30:10 ; Isa 24:2 ; Amos 4:1 ; Zeph 1:9 ; Mal 1:6 (twice in verse); ( c ) husband Judg 19:26-27 , Psa 45:12 ; ( d ) prophet 2Kin 2:3 , 5 , 16 ; ( e ) governor Neh 3:5 ; ( f ) prince Gen 42:10 , 30 , 33 (E) 44:8 (J) 1Sam 29:10 ; ( g ) king Gen 40:1 (E) Judg 3:25 40t. Samuel & Kings; Chronicles only in sources 1Chr 12:19 compare 1Sam 29:4 ; 2Chr 13:6 ; 18:16 = 1Kin 22:17 ; Isa 19:4 ; 22:18 ; 36:12 ; 37:4 , 6 ; Jer 27:4 ; (2) reference to God Mal 1:6 ; הָאֲדֹנִים אֲדֹנֵי Lord of lords Deut 10:17 = Psa 136:3 ; אֲדֹנֵינוּ 135:5 ; 147:5 ; Neh 8:10 ; ׳י אֲדֹנֵינוּ Psa 8:2 ; Psalm 8:10; Neh 10:30 ; י ׳אֲדֹנַיִח Isa 51:22 (probably = thy husband, Yahweh) ; אֲדֹנָיו Hosea 12:15 (possibly error for אֲדֹנָי ). 3 suffix 1 singular אֲדֹנִי (אֲדֹנַי) (1) reference to men: my lord, my master, (a) master Exod 21:5 (Cov't code) Gen 24:12 +, 44:5 (J, 20 t.) 1Sam 30:13 , 15 ; 2Kin 5:3 , 20 , 22 ; 6:15 ; ( b ) husband Gen 18:12 (J); ( c ) prophet 1Kin 18:7 , 13 ; 2Kin 2:19 ; 4:16 , 28 ; 6:5 ; 8:5 ; ( d ) prince Gen 42:10 (E), 23:6 , 11 , 15 (P), 43:20 ; 44:18 +, 47:18 , + (J, 12 t.); Judg 4:18 ; ( e ) king 1Sam 22:12 + (Samuel & Kings 75 t.); ( f ) father Gen 31:35 (E); ( g ) Moses Exod 32:22 ; Num 11:28 ; 12:11 ; 32:26-27 , (J); 36:2 (twice in verse) (P); ( h ) priest 1Sam 1:15 , 26 (twice in verse); ( i ) theophanic angel Josh 5:14 ; Judg 6:13 ; ( j ) captain 2Sam 11:11 ; ( k ) General recognition of superiority Gen 24:18 ; 32:5 + 33:8 +; 44:7 + (J, 13 t.), Ruth 2:13 ; 1Sam 25:24 + (15 t.); (2) reference to God: אֲדֹנָי a. my Lord Gen 20:4 (? E) Exod 15:17 (Samaritan יהוה ) elsewhere in Hexateuch, J; Gen 18:3 (?); 18:27 , 30 , 31 , 32 ; 19:2 , 18 (?) Exod 4:10 ; 4:13 ; 5:22 ; 34:9 ; Num 14:17 ; Josh 7:8 ; also Judg 6:15 ; 13:8 ; not Samuel; 1Kin 22:6 ; 2Kin 19:23 ; not Chron. except memorials Ezra 10:3 (reference to Ezra) Neh 1:11 ; 4:8 ; Wisdom Literature only Job 28:28 (doubtless scribal error for יהוֺה of many MSS.); not Hosea; Isa 37:24 ; 38:14 , 16 (historical part); exile 49:14 (compare 51:22 ); Micah 1:2 ; Psa 16:2 + (47 t., chiefly this sense, except below b. ; compare וַאדֹנָי אֱלֹהַי my Lord and my God 35:23 ; (writers that use אֱלֹהִים seldom use אֲדֹנָי ); b. Adonay proper name of God , parallel with Yahweh , substitution for it often by scribal error, & eventually supplanting it. In earlier Isa 3:17 + (19 t. seeming to belong here), Amos 7:7-8 , 9:1 ; Ezek 18:25 , 29 ; 33:17 , 20 ; 21:14 (probably י ׳אֲדֹנָי as in usual phrase); Zech 9:4 ; Mal 1:12 , 14 ; Lam 1:14 + (14 t.) Psa 2:4 ; 37:13 ; 78:65 ; 90:17 (? יהוה ) 110:5 (Dalman puts most of these below ( a ); — many cases are doubtful); 1Kin 3:10 , 15 (Masoretic אדני for יהוה compare Dalm 2Kin 7:6 ; Dalm rightly questions; he reads יהוה ). The phrases אֱלֹהַי אֲדֹנָי Psa 38:16 ; 86:12 , Adonay my God ; הָאֱלֹהִים אֲדֹנָי Dan 9:3 , ׳א אֱלֹהֵינוּ 9:9 , 15 , ׳א הָאֵל 9:4 favour taking ׳א 1:2 ; 9:7-8 , ( יהוה ?) 9:16 ; 9:17 ; 9:19 ; 9:19 ; 9:19 as the divine name. 4 יהוה אֲדֹנָי ( a ) my Lord Yahweh (see יהוה ) Gen 15:2 , 8 (JE) Josh 7:7 (J, ᵐ5 omit ׳י ) Deut 3:24 ; 9:26 ; Judg 6:22 ; 16:28 ; 2Sam 7:1 (6 t.) 1Kin 2:26 ; 8:53 ; probably Amos 3:7-8 , 7:2 , 4 , 5 ; 9:8 ; Jer 1:6 ; 4:10 ; 14:13 ; 32:17 , 25 ; Ezek 4:14 ; 8:1 ; 9:6 ; 11:13 ; 20:49 ; 37:3 ( ׳י א אֲני כִּי ׳יָדַע ) 13:9 ; 23:49 ; 24:24 ; 28:24 ; 29:16 inappropriate in mouth of God; strike out אֲדֹנָי (Co) or read ׳י אֱלֹהֵיכֶם (Dalm); Micah 1:2 ; Zeph 1:7 ; Obadiah 1; Zech 9:14 ; Psa 71:5 ; 71:16 ; 73:28 ; ( b ) apparently proper name Adonay Yahweh Isa 25:8 ; Jer 44:26 ; exile Isa 40:10 + (10 t., but 61:1 , 11 read ᵐ5 יהוה, ); ( c ) uncertain whether ( a ) or ( b ) in prophetic formula ׳א ׳י אָמַר 7:7 ; 28:16 ; 30:15 ; 49:22 ; 51:4 ; 65:13 ; Jer 7:20 ; Amos 1:8 ; 3:11 ; 5:3 ; 7:6 ; Obadiah 1; Ezekiel (131 t.); א ׳נְאֻם ׳י Isa 56:8 ; Jer 2:22 ; Amos 3:13 ; 4:5 ; 8:3 , 9 , 11 ; Ezekiel (80 t.); ׳דְּבַראֿ ׳י Ezek 6:3 ; 25:3 ; 36:4 ; א ׳נִשְׁבַּע ׳י Amos 4:2 ; 6:8 ; א הִרְאַנִי ׳כֹּה ׳י 7:1 , 4 ; 8:1 . 5 אֲדֹנָי יהוה Yahweh my Lord Psa 68:21 ; 109:21 ; 140:8 ; 141:8 ; Hab 3:9 . 6 צְבָאוֺת יהוה אֲדֹנָי ( a ) my Lord Yahweh ‚ .
